description: ADS-C Air Traffic Data Collected by the OpenSky Network is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marc Xapelli, Martin Strohmeier. ADS-C data collected by the OpenSky Network since 7th July 2023. Data underlying (Version 1.1) A First Look at Exploiting the Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Contract Protocol for Open Aviation Research https://journals.open.tudelft.nl/joas/article/view/7229. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
